name: Adani Samsara Ivana
summary: The project exists. Its developer (Adani Realty), its location (Sector 63/63A, Golf Course Extension Road), its RERA number (RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/896/628/2024/123), the 1,702 sq ft 4 BHK, the 65 buildings and the 260 units are confirmed. Our June 2027 possession is only the developer's target: the RERA possession date is June 2029, which is 2 years later. A second phase, 'Ivana 2.0' (GGM/999/731/2025/102), exists. Land area varies across sources (3.44-7.5 acres), and Square Yards prices start higher (₹6.14 Cr).
